source: Get general information about the Godot project, including name, version, and description.
en: Get general information about the Godot project, including name, version, and description.
zh: 获取 Godot 项目的总体信息，包括名称、版本和描述。

source: Get project settings. Optionally filter by a prefix.
en: Get project settings. Optionally filter by a prefix.
zh: 获取项目设置。可选择按前缀过滤。

source: Discover runnable project tests under the Godot project's test directories. Reports Python integration tests and GUT unit tests, including whether each test is currently runnable.
en: Discover runnable project tests under the Godot project's test directories. Reports Python integration tests and GUT unit tests, including whether each test is currently runnable.
zh: 发现 Godot 项目测试目录下的可运行项目测试。报告 Python 集成测试和 GUT 单元测试，包括每个测试当前是否可运行。

source: Run a single project test script without blocking the editor. The first call starts the run on a background thread and returns status 'pending'; call again with the same test_path to poll for the finished result. Python integration tests are executed with python. GUT unit tests are executed through Godot headless when addons/gut is available.
en: Run a single project test script without blocking the editor. The first call starts the run on a background thread and returns status 'pending'; call again with the same test_path to poll for the finished result. Python integration tests are executed with python. GUT unit tests are executed through Godot headless when addons/gut is available.
zh: 运行单个项目测试脚本，不阻塞编辑器。首次调用在后台线程启动测试并返回状态 'pending'；用相同的 test_path 再次调用以轮询最终结果。Python 集成测试使用 python 执行。GUT 单元测试在 addons/gut 可用时通过 Godot 无头模式执行。

source: Discover and run multiple project tests from a directory without blocking the editor. The first call starts the batch on a background thread and returns status 'pending'; call again with the same arguments to poll for the aggregated result. Reuses the same framework filters as list_project_tests and aggregates pass/fail counts.
en: Discover and run multiple project tests from a directory without blocking the editor. The first call starts the batch on a background thread and returns status 'pending'; call again with the same arguments to poll for the aggregated result. Reuses the same framework filters as list_project_tests and aggregates pass/fail counts.
zh: 从目录中发现并运行多个项目测试，不阻塞编辑器。首次调用在后台线程启动批量运行并返回状态 'pending'；用相同的参数再次调用以轮询聚合结果。使用与 list_project_tests 相同的框架过滤器，并汇总通过/失败计数。

source: Inspect and prepare the project's test environment without requiring GUT or Python. Checks res://test/, res://tests/ and res://.mcp_runtime_tests/ and returns ready/empty/unconfigured/blocked plus a recoverable flag and recommended action.
en: Inspect and prepare the project's test environment without requiring GUT or Python. Checks res://test/, res://tests/ and res://.mcp_runtime_tests/ and returns ready/empty/unconfigured/blocked plus a recoverable flag and recommended action.
zh: 预检并准备项目的测试环境，不依赖 GUT 或 Python。检查 res://test/、res://tests/ 和 res://.mcp_runtime_tests/，返回 ready/empty/unconfigured/blocked，以及 recoverable 标志和推荐动作。

source: Ensure a directory exists under res://. Idempotent and safe: refuses the project root and rejects path escape. Returns 'created' or 'unchanged'.
en: Ensure a directory exists under res://. Idempotent and safe: refuses the project root and rejects path escape. Returns 'created' or 'unchanged'.
zh: 确保 res:// 下存在一个目录。幂等且安全：拒绝项目根目录和路径逃逸。返回 'created' 或 'unchanged'。

source: Generate a minimal framework-independent smoke test under res://test/. The native test checks main-scene load, project file presence and a clean headless run, so an empty project can pass QA without GUT or Python installed.
en: Generate a minimal framework-independent smoke test under res://test/. The native test checks main-scene load, project file presence and a clean headless run, so an empty project can pass QA without GUT or Python installed.
zh: 在 res://test/ 下生成最小且与框架无关的冒烟测试。该原生测试检查主场景加载、项目文件存在和无头运行是否干净，因此空项目无需 GUT 或 Python 也能通过 QA。

source: List project InputMap actions stored in ProjectSettings, including serialized input events.
en: List project InputMap actions stored in ProjectSettings, including serialized input events.
zh: 列出存储在 ProjectSettings 中的项目 InputMap 动作，包括序列化的输入事件。

source: Create or update a project InputMap action in ProjectSettings and save project.godot.
en: Create or update a project InputMap action in ProjectSettings and save project.godot.
zh: 在 ProjectSettings 中创建或更新项目 InputMap 动作并保存 project.godot。

source: Remove a project InputMap action from ProjectSettings and save project.godot.
en: Remove a project InputMap action from ProjectSettings and save project.godot.
zh: 从 ProjectSettings 中移除项目 InputMap 动作并保存 project.godot。

source: List project autoload entries with resolved path, singleton flag, and project setting order.
en: List project autoload entries with resolved path, singleton flag, and project setting order.
zh: 列出项目自动加载条目，包括已解析的路径、单例标志和项目设置顺序。

source: List project global script classes registered through class_name metadata.
en: List project global script classes registered through class_name metadata.
zh: 列出通过 class_name 元数据注册的项目全局脚本类。

source: Get typed API metadata for an engine ClassDB class or a project global script class.
en: Get typed API metadata for an engine ClassDB class or a project global script class.
zh: 获取引擎 ClassDB 类或项目全局脚本类的类型化 API 元数据。

source: Inspect C# / Mono project support files such as .csproj and .sln, including target frameworks, assembly metadata, and references.
en: Inspect C# / Mono project support files such as .csproj and .sln, including target frameworks, assembly metadata, and references.
zh: 检查 C# / Mono 项目支持文件（如 .csproj 和 .sln），包括目标框架、程序集元数据和引用。

source: Compare two screenshot images and report pixel differences, RMSE, and threshold-based match status.
en: Compare two screenshot images and report pixel differences, RMSE, and threshold-based match status.
zh: 比较两张截图图像并报告像素差异、RMSE 和基于阈值的匹配状态。

source: Visual regression gate: compare a candidate screenshot against a stored baseline (golden) image and return pass/fail against tolerances (max_diff_pixels / max_diff_ratio / rmse_threshold). Missing baseline (or update_baseline=true) saves the candidate as the new baseline and passes. Optionally writes a diff heatmap PNG. Dimension mismatches fail.
en: Visual regression gate: compare a candidate screenshot against a stored baseline (golden) image and return pass/fail against tolerances (max_diff_pixels / max_diff_ratio / rmse_threshold). Missing baseline (or update_baseline=true) saves the candidate as the new baseline and passes. Optionally writes a diff heatmap PNG. Dimension mismatches fail.
zh: 视觉回归门禁：将候选截图与存储的基线（黄金）图像比较，按容差（max_diff_pixels / max_diff_ratio / rmse_threshold）返回通过/失败。基线缺失（或 update_baseline=true）时把候选另存为新基线并判为通过。可选写入差异热力图 PNG。尺寸不一致判为失败。

source: Performance budget gate: capture a runtime performance snapshot from the running game and check it against a budget, returning a pass/fail verdict plus a per-metric breakdown. Budget keys: min_fps, max_frame_time_ms, max_physics_frame_time_ms, max_object_count, max_resource_count, max_rendered_objects, max_memory_mb, max_node_count (define only the ones to enforce). min_* checks actual >= limit; max_* checks actual <= limit. Pass an explicit 'snapshot' object to evaluate a previously captured snapshot instead of querying the game. Requires the game to be running with the runtime probe installed (unless 'snapshot' is supplied).
en: Performance budget gate: capture a runtime performance snapshot from the running game and check it against a budget, returning a pass/fail verdict plus a per-metric breakdown. Budget keys: min_fps, max_frame_time_ms, max_physics_frame_time_ms, max_object_count, max_resource_count, max_rendered_objects, max_memory_mb, max_node_count (define only the ones to enforce). min_* checks actual >= limit; max_* checks actual <= limit. Pass an explicit 'snapshot' object to evaluate a previously captured snapshot instead of querying the game. Requires the game to be running with the runtime probe installed (unless 'snapshot' is supplied).
zh: 性能预算门禁：从运行中的游戏采集一次运行时性能快照并按预算校验，返回通过/失败结论及逐指标明细。预算键：min_fps、max_frame_time_ms、max_physics_frame_time_ms、max_object_count、max_resource_count、max_rendered_objects、max_memory_mb、max_node_count（只需定义要强制的项）。min_* 校验 实际值 >= 上限；max_* 校验 实际值 <= 上限。可传入显式的 'snapshot' 对象以评估先前采集的快照而非查询游戏。除非提供 'snapshot'，否则需要游戏正在运行且已安装运行时探针。

source: Runtime-error hard gate: scan the categorized debugger output captured from the running game and fail if any error events are present. By default it inspects the 'stderr' category; pass 'categories' to widen or narrow it, and 'since_sequence' to only consider events newer than a previously recorded sequence number (so you can gate a specific window of a run). Returns passed=false with the captured error events when any are found.
en: Runtime-error hard gate: scan the categorized debugger output captured from the running game and fail if any error events are present. By default it inspects the 'stderr' category; pass 'categories' to widen or narrow it, and 'since_sequence' to only consider events newer than a previously recorded sequence number (so you can gate a specific window of a run). Returns passed=false with the captured error events when any are found.
zh: 运行时报错硬门禁：扫描从运行中游戏捕获的分类调试器输出，只要存在任何报错事件即判为失败。默认检查 'stderr' 分类；可传 'categories' 扩大或缩小范围，并用 'since_sequence' 仅考虑序号大于先前记录值的事件（以便对某段运行窗口设门禁）。发现任何报错时返回 passed=false 并附带捕获到的报错事件。

source: Inspect a TileSet resource and summarize its sources, atlas tiles, and scene tiles.
en: Inspect a TileSet resource and summarize its sources, atlas tiles, and scene tiles.
zh: 检查 TileSet 资源并汇总其来源、图集瓦片和场景瓦片。

source: List project resource files with lossless limit/offset pagination. Follow next_offset while has_more is true; every page reuses one revision-safe scan snapshot.
en: List project resource files with lossless limit/offset pagination. Follow next_offset while has_more is true; every page reuses one revision-safe scan snapshot.
zh: 以无损 limit/offset 分页列出项目资源；has_more 为 true 时跟随 next_offset，所有页面复用同一份 revision 安全扫描快照。

source: Create a new Godot resource file (.tres). Supports common resource types.
en: Create a new Godot resource file (.tres). Supports common resource types.
zh: 创建新的 Godot 资源文件（.tres）。支持常见的资源类型。

source: Create a .tres/.res for a custom class_name Resource (or Resource script by path), setting exported properties. Resolves project global classes, not just built-in engine types.
en: Create a .tres/.res for a custom class_name Resource (or Resource script by path), setting exported properties. Resolves project global classes, not just built-in engine types.
zh: 为自定义 class_name 资源（或按路径指定的 Resource 脚本）创建 .tres/.res 文件并设置导出属性。可解析项目全局类，而不仅限于引擎内置类型。

source: Create many resource files (.tres) in one call from a list spec, with shared defaults each item can override. Ideal for data-driven card, relic, or enemy sets.
en: Create many resource files (.tres) in one call from a list spec, with shared defaults each item can override. Ideal for data-driven card, relic, or enemy sets.
zh: 通过列表规格一次性创建多个资源文件（.tres），共享默认值可被每个条目覆盖。适合数据驱动的卡牌、遗物或敌人集合。

source: Load an existing resource file, set/merge exported properties, and re-save it. Use to tweak data such as card cost or enemy HP.
en: Load an existing resource file, set/merge exported properties, and re-save it. Use to tweak data such as card cost or enemy HP.
zh: 加载已有资源文件，设置/合并导出属性后重新保存。可用于调整卡牌费用或敌人血量等数据。

source: Read a resource file and return its exported properties as JSON-friendly values, optionally including built-in base Resource properties.
en: Read a resource file and return its exported properties as JSON-friendly values, optionally including built-in base Resource properties.
zh: 读取资源文件并以 JSON 友好的形式返回其导出属性，可选地包含内置的基础 Resource 属性。

source: Get project structure and file organization.
en: Get project structure and file organization.
zh: 获取项目结构和文件组织。

source: Reimport project resources.
en: Reimport project resources.
zh: 重新导入项目资源。

source: Get resource import metadata.
en: Get resource import metadata.
zh: 获取资源导入元数据。

source: Get resource UID information.
en: Get resource UID information.
zh: 获取资源 UID 信息。

source: Fix resource UID issues.
en: Fix resource UID issues.
zh: 修复资源 UID 问题。

source: Get resource dependencies.
en: Get resource dependencies.
zh: 获取资源依赖关系。

source: Scan for missing resource dependencies.
en: Scan for missing resource dependencies.
zh: 扫描缺失的资源依赖。

source: Scan for cyclic resource dependencies.
en: Scan for cyclic resource dependencies.
zh: 扫描循环资源依赖。

source: Scan GDScript for syntax errors and lightweight warnings. Default scope is user code; include_tooling=true (or a search_path inside addons/test/docs) audits third-party internals. Per-file results are memoized on mtime+size, so rescans recompile only changed scripts.
en: Scan GDScript for syntax errors and lightweight warnings. Default scope is user code; include_tooling=true (or a search_path inside addons/test/docs) audits third-party internals. Per-file results are memoized on mtime+size, so rescans recompile only changed scripts.
zh: 扫描 GDScript 语法错误与轻量警告。默认只扫用户代码；include_tooling=true（或 search_path 指向 addons/test/docs）可审计第三方插件内部。单文件结果按 mtime+大小记忆，重扫只重编译变更脚本。

source: Audit project health and integrity.
en: Audit project health and integrity.
zh: 审计项目健康和完整性。

source: Find resources that reference a target. Supports lossless limit/offset pages backed by one revision-safe scan.
en: Find resources that reference a target. Supports lossless limit/offset pages backed by one revision-safe scan.
zh: 查找引用目标的资源；支持由同一份 revision 安全扫描快照支撑的无损 limit/offset 分页。

source: List unreferenced resources in lossless limit/offset pages backed by one revision-safe scan. Entry points count as used; class_name-only script references are not tracked.
en: List unreferenced resources in lossless limit/offset pages backed by one revision-safe scan. Entry points count as used; class_name-only script references are not tracked.
zh: 以无损 limit/offset 分页列出未引用资源并复用同一份 revision 安全扫描快照；入口点视为已使用，不跟踪仅通过 class_name 引用的脚本。

source: Scan project .gd/.cs for Godot-version migration issues. Results use lossless limit/offset pages backed by one revision-safe scan; plugin sources are excluded.
en: Scan project .gd/.cs for Godot-version migration issues. Results use lossless limit/offset pages backed by one revision-safe scan; plugin sources are excluded.
zh: 扫描项目 .gd/.cs 的 Godot 版本迁移问题；结果使用同一份 revision 安全扫描快照进行无损 limit/offset 分页，并排除插件自身源码。

source: Apply the safe mechanical migration rewrites for a target Godot release. Defaults to a dry-run preview.
en: Apply the safe mechanical migration rewrites for a target Godot release. Defaults to a dry-run preview.
zh: 为目标 Godot 版本应用安全的机械式迁移改写（如枚举/标识符重命名）。默认仅 dry-run 预览。

source: Create a new Godot scene with a root node. The scene is saved to the specified path.
en: Create a new Godot scene with a root node. The scene is saved to the specified path.
zh: 创建一个新的 Godot 场景并包含根节点。场景保存到指定路径。

source: Save the current scene to disk. If no path is provided, saves to the current scene's path.
en: Save the current scene to disk. If no path is provided, saves to the current scene's path.
zh: 将当前场景保存到磁盘。如果未提供路径，则保存到当前场景的路径。

source: Open a scene file from the project. Closes the current scene if one is open.
en: Open a scene file from the project. Closes the current scene if one is open.
zh: 从项目中打开场景文件。如果当前有打开的场景，则先关闭它。

source: Get information about the currently open scene, including name, path, and root node type.
en: Get information about the currently open scene, including name, path, and root node type.
zh: 获取当前打开场景的信息，包括名称、路径和根节点类型。

source: Get the complete structure of the current scene as a tree. Returns node types, names, and hierarchy.
en: Get the complete structure of the current scene as a tree. Returns node types, names, and hierarchy.
zh: 以树形结构获取当前场景的完整结构。返回节点类型、名称和层级关系。

source: List all scene files (.tscn) in the project. Returns paths relative to res://.
en: List all scene files (.tscn) in the project. Returns paths relative to res://.
zh: 列出项目中所有场景文件（.tscn）。返回相对于 res:// 的路径。

source: List scene tabs currently open in the Godot editor.
en: List scene tabs currently open in the Godot editor.
zh: 列出 Godot 编辑器中当前打开的场景标签页。

source: Close the active scene tab, or activate a specified scene tab and close it.
en: Close the active scene tab, or activate a specified scene tab and close it.
zh: 关闭当前活动的场景标签页，或激活指定的场景标签页然后关闭它。

source: Instance an existing scene file (.tscn) as a child of a node in the currently edited scene. Useful for placing prefabs such as card UIs or enemy instances into the scene tree.
en: Instance an existing scene file (.tscn) as a child of a node in the currently edited scene. Useful for placing prefabs such as card UIs or enemy instances into the scene tree.
zh: 将已有场景文件（.tscn）实例化为当前编辑场景中某个节点的子节点。适合把卡牌 UI、敌人等预制体放入场景树。

source: Save a node and all of its descendants from the currently edited scene as a reusable scene file (.tscn). Useful for extracting a designed UI branch into a prefab. Does not modify the source scene tree.
en: Save a node and all of its descendants from the currently edited scene as a reusable scene file (.tscn). Useful for extracting a designed UI branch into a prefab. Does not modify the source scene tree.
zh: 将当前编辑场景中的某个节点及其全部子节点保存为可复用的场景文件（.tscn）。适合把设计好的 UI 分支提取为预制体。不会修改源场景树。

source: Create a new node in the Godot scene tree. Returns the node path and type.
en: Create a new node in the Godot scene tree. Returns the node path and type.
zh: 在 Godot 场景树中创建新节点。返回节点路径和类型。

source: Delete a node from the Godot scene tree. This operation is destructive and cannot be undone.
en: Delete a node from the Godot scene tree. This operation is destructive and cannot be undone.
zh: 从 Godot 场景树中删除节点。此操作是破坏性的，无法撤销。

source: Update a property of a specific node. Supports common property types with automatic type conversion.
en: Update a property of a specific node. Supports common property types with automatic type conversion.
zh: 更新特定节点的属性。支持常见属性类型并自动进行类型转换。

source: Update multiple node properties inside one editor UndoRedo action. Useful for transaction-style scene edits that should undo in a single step.
en: Update multiple node properties inside one editor UndoRedo action. Useful for transaction-style scene edits that should undo in a single step.
zh: 在一个编辑器 UndoRedo 操作中更新多个节点属性。适用于需要在单步中撤销的事务式场景编辑。

source: Apply ordered scene node edits inside one editor UndoRedo action: create/delete/rename/move nodes plus set_property / attach_script / connect_signal with optional save. Nodes created earlier in the same batch are addressable.
en: Apply ordered scene node edits inside one editor UndoRedo action: create/delete/rename/move nodes plus set_property / attach_script / connect_signal with optional save. Nodes created earlier in the same batch are addressable.
zh: 在单个编辑器 UndoRedo 操作中按序应用创建/删除/重命名/移动场景节点编辑以及 set_property、attach_script、connect_signal，可选保存。同批次先建的节点可直接寻址。

source: Read the properties of multiple nodes in a single call. Returns one result entry per requested node path, reducing round trips when inspecting several nodes.
en: Read the properties of multiple nodes in a single call. Returns one result entry per requested node path, reducing round trips when inspecting several nodes.
zh: 在一次调用中读取多个节点的属性。每个请求的节点路径返回一个结果项，减少检查多个节点时的往返次数。

source: Connect multiple node signals in a single call. Returns one result entry per requested connection, reducing round trips when wiring several signals.
en: Connect multiple node signals in a single call. Returns one result entry per requested connection, reducing round trips when wiring several signals.
zh: 在一次调用中连接多个节点信号。每个请求的连接返回一个结果项，减少连接多个信号时的往返次数。

source: Get all properties of a specific node in the scene tree.
en: Get all properties of a specific node in the scene tree.
zh: 获取场景树中特定节点的所有属性。

source: List all nodes in the current scene or under a specific parent node.
en: List all nodes in the current scene or under a specific parent node.
zh: 列出当前场景或特定父节点下的所有节点。

source: Get the complete scene tree hierarchy starting from the scene root. Returns full tree structure with node types.
en: Get the complete scene tree hierarchy starting from the scene root. Returns full tree structure with node types.
zh: 获取从场景根节点开始的完整场景树层级。返回包含节点类型的完整树结构。

source: Duplicate a node and its children in the scene tree. Returns the new node path.
en: Duplicate a node and its children in the scene tree. Returns the new node path.
zh: 在场景树中复制节点及其子节点。返回新节点的路径。

source: Move a node to a new parent in the scene tree. Optionally preserves global transform.
en: Move a node to a new parent in the scene tree. Optionally preserves global transform.
zh: 将节点移动到场景树中的新父节点下。可选择保留全局变换。

source: Rename a node in the scene tree. The new name must be unique among siblings.
en: Rename a node in the scene tree. The new name must be unique among siblings.
zh: 重命名场景树中的节点。新名称必须在同级节点中唯一。

source: Add a resource child node to a target node.
en: Add a resource child node to a target node.
zh: 向目标节点添加资源子节点。

source: Set anchor preset for a Control node.
en: Set anchor preset for a Control node.
zh: 为 Control 节点设置锚点预设。

source: Connect a signal from one node to another.
en: Connect a signal from one node to another.
zh: 将一个节点的信号连接到另一个节点。

source: Disconnect a signal from one node to another.
en: Disconnect a signal from one node to another.
zh: 断开一个节点到另一个节点的信号连接。

source: Get groups that a node belongs to.
en: Get groups that a node belongs to.
zh: 获取节点所属的组。

source: Set groups for a node.
en: Set groups for a node.
zh: 设置节点所属的组。

source: Find all nodes in a specific group.
en: Find all nodes in a specific group.
zh: 查找特定组中的所有节点。

source: Audit node owner and persistence state for the currently edited scene. Reports missing or invalid owner relationships that affect scene saving and inheritance.
en: Audit node owner and persistence state for the currently edited scene. Reports missing or invalid owner relationships that affect scene saving and inheritance.

source: List scenes and scripts with unsaved edits in the editor buffers using Godot 4.7 APIs.
en: List scenes and scripts with unsaved edits in the editor buffers using Godot 4.7 APIs.
zh: 列出编辑器缓冲区中有未保存改动的场景与脚本（Godot 4.7）。

source: Save every script currently open in the script editor (Godot 4.7).
en: Save every script currently open in the script editor (Godot 4.7).
zh: 保存脚本编辑器中所有打开的脚本（Godot 4.7）。

source: Reload the editor's open script buffers from disk so external rewrites are not overwritten (Godot 4.7).
en: Reload the editor's open script buffers from disk so external rewrites are not overwritten (Godot 4.7).
zh: 从磁盘重新加载编辑器打开的脚本缓冲区避免覆盖外部改写（Godot 4.7）。

source: Close a script tab in the script editor optionally targeting a specific script path (Godot 4.7).
en: Close a script tab in the script editor optionally targeting a specific script path (Godot 4.7).
zh: 关闭脚本编辑器中的标签页可指定脚本路径（Godot 4.7）。

source: Report whether the EditorFileSystem is currently scanning or importing assets (Godot 4.7).
en: Report whether the EditorFileSystem is currently scanning or importing assets (Godot 4.7).
zh: 报告 EditorFileSystem 是否正在扫描或导入资源（Godot 4.7）。

source: Undo the most recent editor action(s). Each editor UndoRedo action typically bundles one scene edit (node create/delete, property change, tile paint) — undo() pops the latest undoable action and restores the previous state. Pass count to undo several actions at once; the loop stops when the undo stack is empty. Returns status 'noop' with message 'Nothing to undo' when the stack is empty.
en: Undo the most recent editor action(s). Each editor UndoRedo action typically bundles one scene edit (node create/delete, property change, tile paint) — undo() pops the latest undoable action and restores the previous state. Pass count to undo several actions at once; the loop stops when the undo stack is empty. Returns status 'noop' with message 'Nothing to undo' when the stack is empty.
zh: 撤销最近的编辑器操作。每个编辑器 UndoRedo 动作通常封装一次场景编辑（创建/删除节点、修改属性、绘制瓦片）——undo() 弹出最近的可撤销动作并恢复先前状态。传入 count 可一次撤销多个动作；撤销栈为空时循环停止。栈为空时返回 status 'noop' 与消息 'Nothing to undo'。

source: Redo the most recently undone editor action(s). Each redo re-applies the next action from the editor's redo stack. Pass count to redo several actions at once; the loop stops when the redo stack is empty. Returns status 'noop' with message 'Nothing to redo' when the stack is empty.
en: Redo the most recently undone editor action(s). Each redo re-applies the next action from the editor's redo stack. Pass count to redo several actions at once; the loop stops when the redo stack is empty. Returns status 'noop' with message 'Nothing to redo' when the stack is empty.
zh: 重做最近被撤销的编辑器操作。每次重做会从编辑器的重做栈中重新应用下一个动作。传入 count 可一次重做多个动作；重做栈为空时循环停止。栈为空时返回 status 'noop' 与消息 'Nothing to redo'。

source: Read-only summary of the editor's UndoRedo stack: how many actions can be undone and redone, plus the names of the most recent undoable and redoable actions (most recent first, capped by 'limit' which defaults to 20).
en: Read-only summary of the editor's UndoRedo stack: how many actions can be undone and redone, plus the names of the most recent undoable and redoable actions (most recent first, capped by 'limit' which defaults to 20).
zh: 编辑器 UndoRedo 栈的只读摘要：可撤销与可重做的动作数量，以及最近的可撤销/可重做动作名称（最近的在前，受 'limit' 截断，默认 20）。

source: Set the Godot 4.7 offset transform of a Control node (offset_transform_position/rotation/scale/pivot plus enabled and visual_only) without affecting layout. Returns status unsupported below Godot 4.7.
en: Set the Godot 4.7 offset transform of a Control node (offset_transform_position/rotation/scale/pivot plus enabled and visual_only) without affecting layout. Returns status unsupported below Godot 4.7.
zh: 设置 Control 节点的 Godot 4.7 偏移变换（位置/旋转/缩放/轴心以及 enabled 和 visual_only）而不影响布局。低于 Godot 4.7 返回 unsupported。

source: Enable or disable one-way collision on a 2D collision node (CollisionShape2D or CollisionPolygon2D) with optional margin and direction. CollisionShape2D one-way collision requires Godot 4.7.
en: Enable or disable one-way collision on a 2D collision node (CollisionShape2D or CollisionPolygon2D) with optional margin and direction. CollisionShape2D one-way collision requires Godot 4.7.
zh: 为 2D 碰撞节点（CollisionShape2D 或 CollisionPolygon2D）启用或禁用单向碰撞，可选 margin 与方向。CollisionShape2D 单向碰撞需要 Godot 4.7。

source: Create and save a GradientTexture2D (.tres) with a configurable color gradient and fill mode (linear radial square or conic). Conic fill requires Godot 4.7.
en: Create and save a GradientTexture2D (.tres) with a configurable color gradient and fill mode (linear radial square or conic). Conic fill requires Godot 4.7.
zh: 创建并保存 GradientTexture2D（.tres），支持可配置的颜色渐变与填充模式（linear、radial、square 或 conic）。conic 填充需要 Godot 4.7。

source: Bundle a set of files into a Godot .pck archive using PCKPacker mapping virtual target paths to existing source files. Useful for building DLC or mod packs.
en: Bundle a set of files into a Godot .pck archive using PCKPacker mapping virtual target paths to existing source files. Useful for building DLC or mod packs.
zh: 使用 PCKPacker 将一组文件打包为 Godot .pck 归档，将虚拟目标路径映射到已存在的源文件。适合构建 DLC 或模组包。

source: Configure project-level render output settings including the Godot 4.7 HDR 2D output (rendering/viewport/hdr_2d) and transparent background. Unavailable keys are reported as unsupported.
en: Configure project-level render output settings including the Godot 4.7 HDR 2D output (rendering/viewport/hdr_2d) and transparent background. Unavailable keys are reported as unsupported.
zh: 配置项目级渲染输出设置，包括 Godot 4.7 HDR 2D 输出（rendering/viewport/hdr_2d）与透明背景。不可用的键报告为 unsupported。

source: Create and save a Godot 4.7 DrawableTexture2D (.tres) a GPU-backed texture you can draw onto at runtime initialized via setup(width height format fill_color use_mipmaps). Requires Godot 4.7 returns unsupported on older versions.
en: Create and save a Godot 4.7 DrawableTexture2D (.tres) a GPU-backed texture you can draw onto at runtime initialized via setup(width height format fill_color use_mipmaps). Requires Godot 4.7 returns unsupported on older versions.
zh: 创建并保存 Godot 4.7 的 DrawableTexture2D（.tres）——一种可在运行时绘制的 GPU 纹理，通过 setup(宽度、高度、格式、填充色、是否 mipmap) 初始化。需要 Godot 4.7，旧版本返回 unsupported。

source: Draw onto an existing Godot 4.7 DrawableTexture2D by blitting source textures onto target rectangles (blit_rect) with an optional modulate color. Requires Godot 4.7 returns unsupported on older versions.
en: Draw onto an existing Godot 4.7 DrawableTexture2D by blitting source textures onto target rectangles (blit_rect) with an optional modulate color. Requires Godot 4.7 returns unsupported on older versions.
zh: 在已有的 Godot 4.7 DrawableTexture2D 上绘制：通过 blit_rect 将源纹理贴到目标矩形，并可附加 modulate 调制色。需要 Godot 4.7，旧版本返回 unsupported。

source: Generate an image/audio asset from a prompt into res://; key from env var. Returns 'unconfigured' when unset; reimports when possible.
en: Generate an image/audio asset from a prompt into res://; key from env var. Returns 'unconfigured' when unset; reimports when possible.
zh: 根据提示词在 res:// 中生成图像/音频资产；外部服务密钥取自环境变量。未配置时返回 'unconfigured'；可用时自动 reimport。

source: Slice a sprite sheet texture into a SpriteFrames resource (.tres), animation-ready in one step. Grid = {h_frames, v_frames} or {cell_width, cell_height}, plus optional margin/spacing; frames row-major from 0. 'animations' (array of {name, frames or start_frame+end_frame, fps, loop}) defines named clips; omit for a looping 'default' clip over all frames. create_scene=true also saves an AnimatedSprite2D scene (first clip autoplays).
en: Slice a sprite sheet texture into a SpriteFrames resource (.tres), animation-ready in one step. Grid = {h_frames, v_frames} or {cell_width, cell_height}, plus optional margin/spacing; frames row-major from 0. 'animations' (array of {name, frames or start_frame+end_frame, fps, loop}) defines named clips; omit for a looping 'default' clip over all frames. create_scene=true also saves an AnimatedSprite2D scene (first clip autoplays).
zh: 将精灵图纹理切片为 SpriteFrames 资源（.tres），一步即可用于动画。网格用 {h_frames, v_frames} 或 {cell_width, cell_height} 指定，可加 margin/spacing；帧按行优先从 0 编号。'animations'（数组，元素为 {name, frames 或 start_frame+end_frame, fps, loop}）定义命名片段；省略时创建覆盖全部帧的循环 'default' 片段。create_scene=true 还会保存挂好 SpriteFrames 的 AnimatedSprite2D 场景（首片段自动播放）。

source: Import a glTF/GLB file with GLTFDocument and report a structural summary (mesh, material, animation, skin, camera, light and node counts plus their names) together with validation warnings (no meshes, meshes without materials, no animations). Use to verify a generated or downloaded 3D asset is usable before wiring it into a scene. Read-only: it parses the file but does not modify the project.
en: Import a glTF/GLB file with GLTFDocument and report a structural summary (mesh, material, animation, skin, camera, light and node counts plus their names) together with validation warnings (no meshes, meshes without materials, no animations). Use to verify a generated or downloaded 3D asset is usable before wiring it into a scene. Read-only: it parses the file but does not modify the project.
zh: 用 GLTFDocument 导入 glTF/GLB 文件并报告结构摘要（网格、材质、动画、蒙皮、相机、灯光与节点的数量及名称）以及校验警告（无网格、有网格但无材质、无动画）。用于在把生成或下载的 3D 资产接入场景前验证其是否可用。只读：仅解析文件，不修改项目。

source: Generate a 3D model (glTF/GLB) from a text prompt via an external provider into res://. Async: submit job, poll status, download, validate. API key from an OS env var (never logged). Returns 'unconfigured' when unset; reimports when possible.
en: Generate a 3D model (glTF/GLB) from a text prompt via an external provider into res://. Async: submit job, poll status, download, validate. API key from an OS env var (never logged). Returns 'unconfigured' when unset; reimports when possible.
zh: 通过外部服务根据文本提示在 res:// 中生成 3D 模型（glTF/GLB）。异步：提交任务、轮询状态、下载、校验。API 密钥从系统环境变量读取（绝不记录日志）。未配置时返回 'unconfigured'；可用时自动 reimport。

source: Automate version + changelog for the ship loop: read the current version from application/config/version, compute the next one (semantic bump major/minor/patch or an explicit version), and unless dry_run write it back to project.godot. When update_changelog is on, prepend a dated entry to changelog_path (default res://CHANGELOG.md). Returns previous/new version and whether files were written.
en: Automate version + changelog for the ship loop: read the current version from application/config/version, compute the next one (semantic bump major/minor/patch or an explicit version), and unless dry_run write it back to project.godot. When update_changelog is on, prepend a dated entry to changelog_path (default res://CHANGELOG.md). Returns previous/new version and whether files were written.
zh: 为出货闭环自动管理版本号与更新日志：从 application/config/version 读取当前版本，计算下一个版本（按 major/minor/patch 语义自增，或使用显式 version），非 dry_run 时写回 project.godot。开启 update_changelog 时在 changelog_path（默认 res://CHANGELOG.md）顶部插入带日期的条目。返回旧/新版本及文件是否写入。

source: Manage locally installed Godot export templates: report status (templates dir installed versions and the official download URL/.tpz filename) install a .tpz/.zip archive or remove an installed version directory. Works on Godot 4.6+.
en: Manage locally installed Godot export templates: report status (templates dir installed versions and the official download URL/.tpz filename) install a .tpz/.zip archive or remove an installed version directory. Works on Godot 4.6+.
zh: 管理本机已安装的 Godot 导出模板：查看状态（模板目录、已安装版本、官方下载 URL 与 .tpz 文件名）、安装 .tpz/.zip 模板包、或删除某个已安装版本目录。Godot 4.6+ 通用。

source: Configure Android options on an existing Android export preset in export_presets.cfg (package name, app name, version code/name, Gradle build, APK/AAB format, SDK levels, architectures, keystore paths). Only sets provided fields; preset platform must be Android. Keystore passwords are NOT written here (set via GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_* env vars). Godot 4.6+.
en: Configure Android options on an existing Android export preset in export_presets.cfg (package name, app name, version code/name, Gradle build, APK/AAB format, SDK levels, architectures, keystore paths). Only sets provided fields; preset platform must be Android. Keystore passwords are NOT written here (set via GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_* env vars). Godot 4.6+.
zh: 在 export_presets.cfg 中配置已有 Android 导出预设的安卓专属选项（包名、应用名、版本号/名称、Gradle 构建、APK/AAB 格式、SDK 级别、架构、keystore 路径）。仅设置提供的字段；预设平台必须是 Android。此处不写入 keystore 密码（通过 GODOT_ANDROID_KEYSTORE_* 环境变量设置）。Godot 4.6+。

source: Create and save a Theme resource (.tres/.theme) for styling Control-based UI such as card and HUD scenes, optionally setting default base scale, font size, and default font. Populate it afterwards with set_theme_item.
en: Create and save a Theme resource (.tres/.theme) for styling Control-based UI such as card and HUD scenes, optionally setting default base scale, font size, and default font. Populate it afterwards with set_theme_item.
zh: 创建并保存 Theme 资源（.tres/.theme），用于为卡牌、HUD 等基于 Control 的 UI 设置样式，可选设置默认缩放、字号和默认字体。之后用 set_theme_item 填充具体项。

source: Load an existing Theme, set one item (color, constant, font_size, font, icon, or stylebox) for a given Control type, and re-save it. Colors/constants/font sizes are given directly; fonts/icons/styleboxes are resource paths.
en: Load an existing Theme, set one item (color, constant, font_size, font, icon, or stylebox) for a given Control type, and re-save it. Colors/constants/font sizes are given directly; fonts/icons/styleboxes are resource paths.
zh: 加载已有 Theme，为指定 Control 类型设置一个项（color、constant、font_size、font、icon 或 stylebox）并重新保存。颜色/常量/字号直接给值；字体/图标/样式盒为资源路径。

source: Set or clear the project-wide default GUI theme (the gui/theme/custom project setting) and persist it to project.godot. Pass clear=true to fall back to the engine default.
en: Set or clear the project-wide default GUI theme (the gui/theme/custom project setting) and persist it to project.godot. Pass clear=true to fall back to the engine default.
zh: 设置或清除项目级默认 GUI 主题（gui/theme/custom 项目设置）并持久化到 project.godot。传 clear=true 可回退到引擎默认主题。

source: Set a project setting (ProjectSettings) and optionally persist it to project.godot. Use for window size, rendering, physics layers, application config, input device settings, etc. Pass value_type to coerce the value to int/float/bool/string/vector2/vector3/color; otherwise the value is stored as provided.
en: Set a project setting (ProjectSettings) and optionally persist it to project.godot. Use for window size, rendering, physics layers, application config, input device settings, etc. Pass value_type to coerce the value to int/float/bool/string/vector2/vector3/color; otherwise the value is stored as provided.
zh: 设置项目设置（ProjectSettings）并可选持久化到 project.godot。用于窗口大小、渲染、物理层、应用配置、输入设备设置等。传 value_type 可将值强制转换为 int/float/bool/string/vector2/vector3/color；否则按原样存储。

source: Register a project autoload singleton (e.g. a GameState/RNG/SaveManager script) and persist it to project.godot. The path must point to an existing .gd/.tscn/.scn/.cs resource. Set enabled=false to register the autoload without the singleton '*' prefix; pass overwrite=true to replace an existing entry of the same name.
en: Register a project autoload singleton (e.g. a GameState/RNG/SaveManager script) and persist it to project.godot. The path must point to an existing .gd/.tscn/.scn/.cs resource. Set enabled=false to register the autoload without the singleton '*' prefix; pass overwrite=true to replace an existing entry of the same name.
zh: 注册项目 autoload 单例（如 GameState/RNG/SaveManager 脚本）并持久化到 project.godot。path 必须指向已存在的 .gd/.tscn/.scn/.cs 资源。enabled=false 时不加单例 '*' 前缀；overwrite=true 可替换同名条目。

source: Remove a project autoload singleton by name and persist the change to project.godot. Returns an error if no autoload with that name exists.
en: Remove a project autoload singleton by name and persist the change to project.godot. Returns an error if no autoload with that name exists.
zh: 按名称移除项目 autoload 单例并将更改持久化到 project.godot。若不存在同名 autoload 则返回错误。

source: Create and save an Animation resource (.tres/.res/.anim) for editor-phase authoring of card, UI, and FX motion played by an AnimationPlayer at runtime. Set length (seconds), loop_mode (none/linear/pingpong), and step. Use insert_animation_keys to add tracks and keyframes.
en: Create and save an Animation resource (.tres/.res/.anim) for editor-phase authoring of card, UI, and FX motion played by an AnimationPlayer at runtime. Set length (seconds), loop_mode (none/linear/pingpong), and step. Use insert_animation_keys to add tracks and keyframes.
zh: 创建并保存一个 Animation 资源（.tres/.res/.anim），用于在编辑期编排卡牌、UI 和特效动画，运行时由 AnimationPlayer 播放。可设置 length（秒）、loop_mode（none/linear/pingpong）和 step。随后使用 insert_animation_keys 添加轨道和关键帧。

source: Load an existing Animation, ensure a track for the given path exists, insert keyframes, and re-save. track_type 'value' targets a 'Node:property' path; position_3d/rotation_3d/scale_3d target a node path (value_type coerces value-track keys). attach_player_node adds the finished animation to that AnimationPlayer's default library as animation_name.
en: Load an existing Animation, ensure a track for the given path exists, insert keyframes, and re-save. track_type 'value' targets a 'Node:property' path; position_3d/rotation_3d/scale_3d target a node path (value_type coerces value-track keys). attach_player_node adds the finished animation to that AnimationPlayer's default library as animation_name.
zh: 载入既有 Animation，确保目标轨道存在并插入关键帧后保存。track_type 'value' 走 'Node:property' 路径；position_3d/rotation_3d/scale_3d 走节点路径（value_type 强转值类型）。attach_player_node 会把完成的动画以 animation_name 加入该 AnimationPlayer 的默认库。

source: Create and save a TileSet resource (.tres/.res) for 2D tile maps used by a TileMapLayer (Godot 4.x). Sets tile_size and optionally adds a TileSetAtlasSource from a texture (texture_region_size defaults to tile_size). When create_tiles is true every grid cell that fits in the texture becomes a tile. Returns the atlas source_id and tiles_created.
en: Create and save a TileSet resource (.tres/.res) for 2D tile maps used by a TileMapLayer (Godot 4.x). Sets tile_size and optionally adds a TileSetAtlasSource from a texture (texture_region_size defaults to tile_size). When create_tiles is true every grid cell that fits in the texture becomes a tile. Returns the atlas source_id and tiles_created.
zh: 创建并保存 TileSet 资源（.tres/.res），供 TileMapLayer（Godot 4.x）使用。设置 tile_size，可选地从纹理添加 TileSetAtlasSource（texture_region_size 默认等于 tile_size）。create_tiles 为 true 时，纹理内每个网格单元都会创建为图块。返回图集 source_id 和 tiles_created。

source: Set or erase a batch of cells on a TileMapLayer node (Godot 4.x) in the currently edited scene using the single-layer TileMapLayer API. Each cell is {coords:[x,y], source_id, atlas_coords:[x,y], alternative} or {coords:[x,y], erase:true}. Assign a TileSet to the layer so painted cells render. Wrapped in editor UndoRedo.
en: Set or erase a batch of cells on a TileMapLayer node (Godot 4.x) in the currently edited scene using the single-layer TileMapLayer API. Each cell is {coords:[x,y], source_id, atlas_coords:[x,y], alternative} or {coords:[x,y], erase:true}. Assign a TileSet to the layer so painted cells render. Wrapped in editor UndoRedo.
zh: 在当前编辑场景中，使用单层 TileMapLayer（Godot 4.x）API 批量设置或擦除 TileMapLayer 节点的单元格。每个单元为 {coords:[x,y], source_id, atlas_coords:[x,y], alternative} 或 {coords:[x,y], erase:true}。需给该层指定 TileSet 才能显示绘制的单元。已用编辑器 UndoRedo 包裹。

source: Read cells from a TileMapLayer node (Godot 4.x) in the currently edited scene. Without coords it returns every used cell; with coords (array of [x,y]) it returns just those. Each cell reports source_id, atlas_coords and alternative (source_id -1 means empty).
en: Read cells from a TileMapLayer node (Godot 4.x) in the currently edited scene. Without coords it returns every used cell; with coords (array of [x,y]) it returns just those. Each cell reports source_id, atlas_coords and alternative (source_id -1 means empty).
zh: 在当前编辑场景中读取 TileMapLayer（Godot 4.x）节点的单元格。不传 coords 时返回所有已用单元；传 coords（[x,y] 数组）时仅返回这些单元。每个单元包含 source_id、atlas_coords 和 alternative（source_id 为 -1 表示空）。

source: Create an inline sub-resource of a built-in Resource type, set its properties, and assign it to a node property in the edited scene (wrapped in editor UndoRedo). Use this to set up things like CollisionShape2D.shape = RectangleShape2D{size:[64,32]}, Sprite2D.material = CanvasItemMaterial, or Line2D.gradient = Gradient. Unlike add_resource (which creates child nodes) this writes the sub-resource's own properties.
en: Create an inline sub-resource of a built-in Resource type, set its properties, and assign it to a node property in the edited scene (wrapped in editor UndoRedo). Use this to set up things like CollisionShape2D.shape = RectangleShape2D{size:[64,32]}, Sprite2D.material = CanvasItemMaterial, or Line2D.gradient = Gradient. Unlike add_resource (which creates child nodes) this writes the sub-resource's own properties.
zh: 在当前编辑场景中创建一个内置 Resource 类型的内联子资源，设置其属性后赋给节点的某个属性（用编辑器 UndoRedo 包裹）。可用于设置 CollisionShape2D.shape = RectangleShape2D{size:[64,32]}、Sprite2D.material = CanvasItemMaterial 或 Line2D.gradient = Gradient 等。与 add_resource（创建子节点）不同，本工具会写入子资源自身的属性。

source: Read the inline sub-resource currently assigned to a node's Object property in the edited scene (e.g. inspect CollisionShape2D.shape size, or a material's fields). Returns the resource class and its storage properties in a JSON-friendly form. 'has_resource' is false when the property is null.
en: Read the inline sub-resource currently assigned to a node's Object property in the edited scene (e.g. inspect CollisionShape2D.shape size, or a material's fields). Returns the resource class and its storage properties in a JSON-friendly form. 'has_resource' is false when the property is null.
zh: 读取当前编辑场景中节点某个 Object 属性上已赋的内联子资源（例如查看 CollisionShape2D.shape 的尺寸或材质字段）。以 JSON 友好形式返回资源类名及其存储属性。当该属性为空时 has_resource 为 false。

source: Add and configure layers on an existing TileSet (.tres/.res): physics layers (collision_layer/mask bitmasks), navigation layers, custom data layers (name + Variant type), and terrain sets with terrains (name, color, match mode). New layers are appended; existing ones are preserved. Saves the TileSet. Use after create_tileset so tiles can support collision, autotiling, navigation, and per-tile metadata.
en: Add and configure layers on an existing TileSet (.tres/.res): physics layers (collision_layer/mask bitmasks), navigation layers, custom data layers (name + Variant type), and terrain sets with terrains (name, color, match mode). New layers are appended; existing ones are preserved. Saves the TileSet. Use after create_tileset so tiles can support collision, autotiling, navigation, and per-tile metadata.
zh: 在已有 TileSet (.tres/.res) 上追加并配置图层：物理层（collision_layer/mask 位掩码）、导航层、自定义数据层（名称 + Variant 类型）、以及带地形（名称/颜色/匹配模式）的地形集。新图层为追加，原有图层保留。保存 TileSet。配合 create_tileset 使用，让图块支持碰撞、自动拼接、寻路与逐图块元数据。

source: Set a collision polygon on a tile in a TileSet atlas source, on a given physics layer. Provide explicit polygon points, or omit them to auto-generate a full-tile rectangle (sized to tile_size) so the tile becomes solid. Optionally mark it one-way. The physics layer must already exist (configure_tileset_layers). Saves the TileSet.
en: Set a collision polygon on a tile in a TileSet atlas source, on a given physics layer. Provide explicit polygon points, or omit them to auto-generate a full-tile rectangle (sized to tile_size) so the tile becomes solid. Optionally mark it one-way. The physics layer must already exist (configure_tileset_layers). Saves the TileSet.
zh: 在 TileSet atlas 源的某图块上、指定物理层设置碰撞多边形。可传显式多边形点，或省略以自动按 tile_size 生成整格矩形（让图块变实心）。可标记为单向碰撞。物理层须已存在（见 configure_tileset_layers）。保存 TileSet。

source: Assign a terrain set and terrain to a tile in a TileSet atlas source, and optionally set terrain peering bits for autotiling. The terrain set and terrain must already exist (configure_tileset_layers). peering_bits maps neighbor names (right_side, bottom_side, left_side, top_side, and the four corners) to a terrain index. Saves the TileSet.
en: Assign a terrain set and terrain to a tile in a TileSet atlas source, and optionally set terrain peering bits for autotiling. The terrain set and terrain must already exist (configure_tileset_layers). peering_bits maps neighbor names (right_side, bottom_side, left_side, top_side, and the four corners) to a terrain index. Saves the TileSet.
zh: 为 TileSet atlas 源的某图块指定地形集与地形，并可设置用于自动拼接的地形 peering 位。地形集与地形须已存在（见 configure_tileset_layers）。peering_bits 将邻居名称（right_side、bottom_side、left_side、top_side 及四个角）映射到地形索引。保存 TileSet。

source: Persistent task graph + Definition-of-Done (DoD) in JSON (default res://.mcp/task_plan.json). Actions: init, add_task, update_task, set_status (done needs DoD unless force), set_dod, get, next, remove_task.
en: Persistent task graph + Definition-of-Done (DoD) in JSON (default res://.mcp/task_plan.json). Actions: init, add_task, update_task, set_status (done needs DoD unless force), set_dod, get, next, remove_task.
zh: 持久化任务图 + 完成定义（DoD），以 JSON 存储（默认 res://.mcp/task_plan.json）。操作：init、add_task、update_task、set_status（置为 done 需满足 DoD，除非 force）、set_dod、get、next、remove_task。

source: Patch a GDScript (.gd) or C# (.cs) file with anchored text replacements instead of rewriting the whole file. Every patch must match exactly once unless allow_multiple; the file is written only after all patches match, and a failing .gd compile check restores the original content.
en: Patch a GDScript (.gd) or C# (.cs) file with anchored text replacements instead of rewriting the whole file. Every patch must match exactly once unless allow_multiple; the file is written only after all patches match, and a failing .gd compile check restores the original content.
zh: 用锚点文本替换修补 GDScript (.gd) 或 C# (.cs) 文件，而非整文件重写。每个补丁默认必须恰好匹配一处（可用 allow_multiple 放开）；全部匹配后才写盘，.gd 补丁后编译失败会自动恢复原内容。

source: Compile or resume a durable complete-game DAG from 12 composable profiles. Unknown goals and missing capabilities block; status, replan and cancel preserve explicit control.
en: Compile or resume a durable complete-game DAG from 12 composable profiles. Unknown goals and missing capabilities block; status, replan and cancel preserve explicit control.
zh: 从 12 类可组合制作能力编译或恢复持久化完整游戏 DAG。未知目标和缺失能力会阻塞；status、replan 与 cancel 保留明确控制。

source: Advance an adaptive authorized DAG slice. Budgets yield but never drop work; async waits, safe restart recovery, caches, protected paths, integrity and objective evidence remain enforced.
en: Advance an adaptive authorized DAG slice. Budgets yield but never drop work; async waits, safe restart recovery, caches, protected paths, integrity and objective evidence remain enforced.
zh: 推进自适应的已授权 DAG 切片。预算只会产生可续作让步，绝不删除任务；异步等待、安全重启恢复、缓存、保护路径、完整性与客观完成证据始终生效。

source: Localization workflow: 'extract' scans .tscn translatable properties (text/tooltip_text/placeholder_text/title/hint_tooltip) and .gd tr()/atr() calls, merging new keys into a standard CSV (first column keys, one per locale) while preserving existing translations; 'import' builds one .translation per locale from the CSV and registers it in ProjectSettings; 'export' writes registered .translations back to CSV; 'list' shows registered locales. Write actions support dry_run.
en: Localization workflow: 'extract' scans .tscn translatable properties (text/tooltip_text/placeholder_text/title/hint_tooltip) and .gd tr()/atr() calls, merging new keys into a standard CSV (first column keys, one per locale) while preserving existing translations; 'import' builds one .translation per locale from the CSV and registers it in ProjectSettings; 'export' writes registered .translations back to CSV; 'list' shows registered locales. Write actions support dry_run.
zh: 本地化工作流：'extract' 扫描 .tscn 可翻译属性（text/tooltip_text/placeholder_text/title/hint_tooltip）与 .gd 中的 tr()/atr() 调用，将新键合并进标准 CSV（首列为 keys，每个 locale 一列）并保留已有译文；'import' 从 CSV 为每个 locale 生成一个 .translation 并注册到 ProjectSettings；'export' 把已注册的 .translation 回写为 CSV；'list' 列出已注册的 locale。写操作均支持 dry_run。

source: Drive the running game through scripted input steps and runtime assertions into one pass/fail report. Steps send input actions/events with optional waits and screenshots; assertions check runtime expressions, optionally vs expected. deterministic=true frame-steps waits exactly in-game and 'sample' builds a trajectory with per-label metrics. Captured runtime errors fail by default. Requires the game running with the runtime probe installed.
en: Drive the running game through scripted input steps and runtime assertions into one pass/fail report. Steps send input actions/events with optional waits and screenshots; assertions check runtime expressions, optionally vs expected. deterministic=true frame-steps waits exactly in-game and 'sample' builds a trajectory with per-label metrics. Captured runtime errors fail by default. Requires the game running with the runtime probe installed.
zh: 按脚本化的输入步骤与运行时断言驱动运行中的游戏，返回单一通过/失败报告。步骤发送输入动作/事件，可带等待与截图；断言检查运行时表达式，可配合 expected 比较。deterministic=true 时 wait_frames 在游戏内精确按帧推进，'sample' 记录逐帧轨迹与逐标签指标。运行期捕获到的报错默认计入失败。需要游戏正在运行且已安装运行时探针。

source: Browse registered MCP tool groups without loading every schema. Start with summary_only=true for token-cheap group counts; for a task lookup prefer search_tools. Filter by group/query for per-tool entries, and send a previous catalog_revision as known_revision to receive a minimal not_modified response when nothing changed.
en: Browse registered MCP tool groups without loading every schema. Start with summary_only=true for token-cheap group counts; for a task lookup prefer search_tools. Filter by group/query for per-tool entries, and send a previous catalog_revision as known_revision to receive a minimal not_modified response when nothing changed.
zh: 浏览已注册的 MCP 工具分组而不加载全部 schema。先用 summary_only=true 获取低 token 的分组计数；按任务查找时优先使用 search_tools。需要逐工具条目时再按 group/query 过滤；后续可把 catalog_revision 作为 known_revision 传回，目录未变化时仅返回精简的 not_modified 响应。

source: Route and activate the minimum tools for workflow_query in one call, replacing old supplementary task tools by default. Or change explicit tools, groups or a preset. Core/meta stay on; the response is compact.
en: Route and activate the minimum tools for workflow_query in one call, replacing old supplementary task tools by default. Or change explicit tools, groups or a preset. Core/meta stay on; the response is compact.
zh: 一次调用即可为 workflow_query 路由并启用最小工具集，默认替换上一任务的高级工具。也可显式切换工具、分组或预设。核心/元工具始终启用；响应保持精简。

source: Find tools locally from an English or Chinese intent. mode='tools' ranks single capabilities; mode='workflow' returns at most 10 schema-free names grouped as inspect/execute/verify and can route every non-meta atomic tool. Enable returned names in one call.
en: Find tools locally from an English or Chinese intent. mode='tools' ranks single capabilities; mode='workflow' returns at most 10 schema-free names grouped as inspect/execute/verify and can route every non-meta atomic tool. Enable returned names in one call.
zh: 根据中英文意图在本地查找工具。mode='tools' 排序单项能力；mode='workflow' 最多返回 10 个按检查/执行/验证分组且不含 Schema 的名称，并可路由全部非 Meta 原子工具。随后用一次调用启用返回的名称。

source: Return the full registration record for one MCP tool — complete description, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations, category, group and enabled state — so a client can fetch the exact schema before calling a tool without loading every tool. Use list_tool_catalog or search_tools to discover tool names first. Returns found=false with a hint when the name is not registered.
en: Return the full registration record for one MCP tool — complete description, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations, category, group and enabled state — so a client can fetch the exact schema before calling a tool without loading every tool. Use list_tool_catalog or search_tools to discover tool names first. Returns found=false with a hint when the name is not registered.
zh: 返回单个 MCP 工具的完整注册信息——完整描述、inputSchema、outputSchema、annotations、类别、分组和启用状态，让客户端在调用工具前获取精确 schema，而无需加载全部工具。可先用 list_tool_catalog 或 search_tools 发现工具名称；名称未注册时返回 found=false 并附建议。

source: Batch-verify the compilation status of project scripts, returning per-script structured errors and warnings with line numbers. With no script_paths it scans the whole project for .gd scripts (skipping res://addons/ and res://test/ by default to avoid false positives from the plugin itself and the test suite), capped by max_scripts. Use after editing code as a verification step, complementing validate_script (single script) and execute_editor_script (full reload).
en: Batch-verify the compilation status of project scripts, returning per-script structured errors and warnings with line numbers. With no script_paths it scans the whole project for .gd scripts (skipping res://addons/ and res://test/ by default to avoid false positives from the plugin itself and the test suite), capped by max_scripts. Use after editing code as a verification step, complementing validate_script (single script) and execute_editor_script (full reload).
zh: 批量校验项目脚本的编译状态，返回每个脚本带行号的结构化错误/警告。不传 script_paths 时默认扫描项目内全部 .gd 脚本（默认跳过 res://addons/ 与 res://test/，避免插件自身与测试脚本误报），受 max_scripts 上限约束。适合改代码后的验证环节，与 validate_script（单脚本）和 execute_editor_script（全量重载）互补。

source: Create an export preset in export_presets.cfg (platform, name, export_path, filters, options). if_exists='reuse' makes duplicate names an idempotent success returning the existing preset. Atomic, validated and undoable via source control.
en: Create an export preset in export_presets.cfg (platform, name, export_path, filters, options). if_exists='reuse' makes duplicate names an idempotent success returning the existing preset. Atomic, validated and undoable via source control.
zh: 在 export_presets.cfg 创建导出预设（平台、名称、export_path、过滤器、选项）。if_exists='reuse' 让重名创建成为幂等成功并返回既有预设。原子写入、带校验、可用版本控制回退。

source: Duplicate an existing export preset under a new name (options copied, export path suffixed).
en: Duplicate an existing export preset under a new name (options copied, export path suffixed).
zh: 以新名称复制既有导出预设（复制 options，自动调整导出路径后缀）。

source: Inspect export presets from export_presets.cfg: platform, export path, filters and per-preset options, plus editor platform availability.
en: Inspect export presets from export_presets.cfg: platform, export path, filters and per-preset options, plus editor platform availability.
zh: 检查 export_presets.cfg 中的导出预设：平台、导出路径、过滤条件与逐预设选项，并报告编辑器平台可用性。

source: Remove an export preset section (and its options) from export_presets.cfg.
en: Remove an export preset section (and its options) from export_presets.cfg.
zh: 从 export_presets.cfg 移除一个导出预设（含其 options 节）。

source: Update fields/options of an existing export preset. Only provided keys change.
en: Update fields/options of an existing export preset. Only provided keys change.
zh: 更新既有导出预设的字段/选项，仅改动提供的键。

source: Read shared tool-result cache telemetry: hit/reuse rates, entries vs capacity, byte pressure, single-flight merges, tool-list and read-snapshot caches, external-change invalidation and spill counters.
en: Read shared tool-result cache telemetry: hit/reuse rates, entries vs capacity, byte pressure, single-flight merges, tool-list and read-snapshot caches, external-change invalidation and spill counters.
zh: 读取共享工具结果缓存遥测：命中/复用率、条目与容量、字节压力、single-flight 合并、tools/list 与读快照缓存、外部变更失效与溢出计数。
